title: JobSearchDocument
description: Denormalized OpenSearch document representing a job for search and detail. Source of truth is `jobs` table in `job-service`. Document id = job_id. Tenant filter is mandatory at query time.

tenant_id.description: Owning tenant. Mandatory query filter applied by search-gateway.

job_id.description: Job aggregate id. Equals OpenSearch document _id.

organization_id.description: Sub-tenant employer entity. Defaults to tenant default org for MVP.

description_text.description: Full description text used for analyzed search. May be plain text or normalized markdown.

company_name.description: Display company name (snapshot at index time).

location.description: Composite display location, e.g. 'Remote (US)' or 'Berlin, Germany'.

skills.description: Normalized skill keywords. Indexed as keyword for facets and filters.

status.description: DRAFT/CLOSED/ARCHIVED documents are typically deleted from the index, but status is included for safety filters.

published_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC. Used for recency decay scoring and sort by date.

boost_score.description: Sponsored ranking boost. Capped at JOBOCATE_MAX_BOOST in the gateway.

facets.description: Computed display facet values, e.g. salary_band, experience_band. Pre-computed by projector to keep query-time logic simple.

title_vector.description: Optional dense embedding for hybrid kNN ranking. Length must match the index mapping (currently dim 128 for the deterministic stub embedding worker; will rise to model-native dim once a real model is wired). Supplied to the document by the projector after the embedding-worker emits EMBEDDING_READY for the job title.

embedding_model.description: Identifier of the embedding model used (e.g., 'pseudo-dev', 'bge-base-en-v1.5').
